title: CAPITAL
CITY
TRAPS
hook: True or false? Five capital city traps. Three seconds each, and the last one sounds made up!

qs.q: Toronto is the capital of Canada.
qs.fact: The capital is Ottawa. Toronto is just the biggest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Ottawa. Toronto is just the biggest city.

qs.q: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.
qs.fact: Wellington is the capital. Auckland is the largest city.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Wellington is the capital. Auckland is only the largest city.

qs.q: Rio de Janeiro is the capital of Brazil.
qs.fact: Brasília replaced Rio as the capital in 1960.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Brasilia replaced Rio as the capital back in 1960.

qs.q: South Africa has three capital cities.
qs.fact: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein share the job.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein share the job.

qs.q: Nauru has no official capital city.
qs.fact: The tiny Pacific island nation has no cities. Yaren is only the de facto capital.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The tiny Pacific nation has no cities. Its government simply sits in the Yaren district.

title: YOUR MAP
IS LYING
TO YOU
hook: True or false? Flat maps stretch the truth. Five size facts, three seconds each. The last one fools map lovers!

qs.q: Greenland is about the same size as Africa.
qs.fact: It only looks that way on Mercator maps. Africa is 14 times larger.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It only looks that way on flat maps. Africa is 14 times larger.

qs.q: Antarctica is bigger than Europe.
qs.fact: Antarctica is 14.2 million km², about 40% larger than Europe.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Antarctica is about 40 percent larger than Europe.

qs.q: Almost all of South America lies east of Florida.
qs.fact: South America sits far to the east. Nearly all of it is east of Miami.
qs.sayAnswer: True! South America sits far to the east. Nearly all of it is east of Miami.

qs.q: Brazil is bigger than the contiguous United States.
qs.fact: Brazil: 8.5 million km². The lower 48 states: 8.1 million km².
qs.sayAnswer: True! Brazil is slightly bigger than the lower 48 states put together.

qs.q: Alaska is bigger than Mexico.
qs.fact: Mexico is 1.96 million km². Alaska is 1.72 million km².
qs.sayAnswer: False! Maps inflate Alaska. Mexico is actually the bigger one.

title: USA
GEOGRAPHY
TRAPS
hook: True or false? Five U.S. geography traps, three seconds each. The last one catches almost everybody!

qs.q: New York City is the capital of New York State.
qs.fact: The state capital is Albany. New York City is just the biggest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The state capital is Albany. New York City is just the biggest city.

qs.q: Florida is the southernmost US state.
qs.say: Florida is the southernmost U.S. state.
qs.fact: Hawaii reaches much farther south, at Ka Lae on the Big Island.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Hawaii reaches much farther south than Florida does.

qs.q: Four US states meet at one single point.
qs.say: Four U.S. states meet at one single point.
qs.fact: At Four Corners: Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah.
qs.sayAnswer: True! At Four Corners you can touch Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah at once.

qs.q: Reno, Nevada is farther west than Los Angeles.
qs.fact: Reno is at 119.8° west. Los Angeles is at about 118.2° west.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The California coast curves east, so Reno ends up west of Los Angeles.

qs.q: The closest US state to Africa is Maine.
qs.say: The closest U.S. state to Africa is Maine.
qs.fact: Quoddy Head, Maine is about 5,076 km from the coast of Morocco.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Maine's Quoddy Head is about 5000 kilometers from Morocco. Closer than Florida!

title: EUROPE
WILL FOOL
YOU
hook: True or false? Five facts about Europe, three seconds each. Wait for the border at the end!

qs.q: Rome is farther north than New York City.
qs.fact: Rome sits at 41.9° north. New York City is at 40.7° north.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Rome sits more than 1 degree of latitude north of New York City.

qs.q: Great Britain and the United Kingdom are the same thing.
qs.fact: Great Britain is the island. The UK also includes Northern Ireland.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Great Britain is the island. The United Kingdom also includes Northern Ireland.

qs.q: Most of Iceland is covered in ice.
qs.fact: Glaciers cover only about 10% of Iceland.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Glaciers cover only about 10 percent of Iceland.

qs.q: Monaco is smaller than New York's Central Park.
qs.fact: Monaco covers 2.08 km². Central Park covers 3.41 km².
qs.sayAnswer: True! Monaco covers about 2 square kilometers. Central Park is over 3.

qs.q: France's longest land border is with Brazil.
qs.fact: French Guiana borders Brazil for 730 km. The border with Spain is 623 km.
qs.sayAnswer: True! French Guiana, part of France, borders Brazil for 730 kilometers.

title: TÜRKİYE
TRUE OR
FALSE?
hook: True or false? Five facts about Turkey, three seconds each. Number five surprises people every Christmas!

qs.q: Ankara is Türkiye's largest city.
qs.fact: Ankara is the capital. Istanbul is by far the largest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Ankara is the capital, but Istanbul is by far the largest city.

qs.q: The ancient city of Troy is in Türkiye.
qs.say: The ancient city of Troy is in Turkey.
qs.fact: The ruins of Troy lie in Çanakkale province, in the northwest.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The ruins of Troy lie in northwestern Turkey, not in Greece.

qs.q: Most of Türkiye's land is in Europe.
qs.say: Most of Turkey's land is in Europe.
qs.fact: About 97% of Türkiye lies in Asia. Only about 3% is in Europe.
qs.sayAnswer: False! About 97 percent of Turkey lies in Asia.

qs.q: Türkiye borders eight countries.
qs.fact: Greece, Bulgaria, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Iraq and Syria.
qs.sayAnswer: True! From Greece and Bulgaria all the way round to Iraq and Syria. 8 neighbors.

qs.q: The real Saint Nicholas, the origin of Santa Claus, lived in Türkiye.
qs.say: The real Saint Nicholas, the origin of Santa Claus, lived in Turkey.
qs.fact: He was bishop of Myra, today's Demre on the Mediterranean coast.
qs.sayAnswer: True! He was bishop of Myra, now the town of Demre on Turkey's south coast.

title: OCEAN
SECRETS
REVEALED
hook: True or false? Five ocean facts, three seconds each. The last one is hiding deep underwater!

qs.q: Water covers about 71% of Earth's surface.
qs.say: Water covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface.
qs.fact: About 71% of our planet's surface is covered by water.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Roughly 71 percent of our planet's surface is covered by water.

qs.q: The Atlantic is the deepest ocean.
qs.fact: The Pacific is. Its Mariana Trench plunges almost 11 km down.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The Pacific is. Its Mariana Trench plunges almost 11 kilometers down.

qs.q: The Pacific Ocean is bigger than all of Earth's land combined.
qs.fact: The Pacific covers 165 million km². All land adds up to about 149 million.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The Pacific is so vast that every continent could fit inside it.

qs.q: Point Nemo, the ocean's most remote spot, is in the Atlantic.
qs.fact: It is in the South Pacific, about 2,688 km from the nearest land.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It is in the South Pacific, almost 2700 kilometers from the nearest land.

qs.q: The world's largest waterfall is underwater.
qs.fact: The Denmark Strait cataract drops about 3.5 km beneath the sea surface.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Between Iceland and Greenland, cold water plunges about 3 and a half kilometers down.

title: MOUNTAIN
MYTHS
BUSTED
hook: True or false? Five mountain facts, three seconds each. Number five makes Everest look small!

qs.q: Mount Kilimanjaro is in Kenya.
qs.fact: Africa's highest mountain stands entirely in Tanzania.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Africa's highest mountain stands entirely in Tanzania.

qs.q: K2 is the second-highest mountain on Earth.
qs.fact: K2 rises 8,611 m. Only Mount Everest is higher.
qs.sayAnswer: True! K2 rises 8611 meters. Only Everest is higher.

qs.q: Every mountain above 8,000 metres is in Asia.
qs.say: Every mountain above 8000 meters is in Asia.
qs.fact: All 14 are in the Himalaya and Karakoram ranges.
qs.sayAnswer: True! All 14 of them are in the Himalaya and Karakoram ranges.

qs.q: Mount Everest sits on the border of Nepal and India.
qs.fact: Its summit is on the border between Nepal and China.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Its summit is on the border between Nepal and China.

qs.q: Measured from its base, Mauna Kea is taller than Mount Everest.
qs.fact: From the ocean floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea rises more than 10,210 m.
qs.sayAnswer: True! From the sea floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea rises more than 10000 meters.

title: ISLAND
FACTS
OR FAKES?
hook: True or false? Five island facts, three seconds each. The last one sounds impossible!

qs.q: Madagascar is the world's largest island.
qs.fact: Greenland is the largest. Madagascar is only fourth.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Greenland is the largest. Madagascar ranks only fourth.

qs.q: The island of Borneo is shared by three countries.
qs.fact: Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei all have territory on Borneo.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei all have territory on Borneo.

qs.q: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean.
qs.fact: Sicily is about 25,500 km², just ahead of Sardinia.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Sicily is the largest, just ahead of Sardinia.

qs.q: Japan is made up of just four islands.
qs.fact: A 2023 government count found 14,125 islands.
qs.sayAnswer: False! A 2023 government count found 14125 islands.

qs.q: More people live on the island of Java than in all of Russia.
qs.fact: Java: about 158 million people. Russia: about 146 million.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Java has about 158 million people. Russia has about 146 million.

title: BIZARRE
BORDER
FACTS
hook: True or false? Five strange border facts, three seconds each. Wait until you hear number five!

qs.q: The border between the US and Canada is the world's longest.
qs.say: The border between the U.S. and Canada is the world's longest.
qs.fact: It runs 8,891 km, including the border with Alaska.
qs.sayAnswer: True! It runs 8891 kilometers, including the border with Alaska.

qs.q: Brazil borders every other country in South America.
qs.fact: Close! Brazil touches all of them except Chile and Ecuador.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Close! Brazil touches all of them except Chile and Ecuador.

qs.q: Mongolia shares a border with Kazakhstan.
qs.fact: Mongolia has only two neighbours: Russia and China.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Mongolia has only 2 neighbors, Russia and China.

qs.q: North Korea shares a border with Russia.
qs.fact: They meet along the Tumen River for about 17 km.
qs.sayAnswer: True! They meet along the Tumen River for about 17 kilometers.

qs.q: Canada shares a land border with Denmark.
qs.fact: In 2022 they split tiny Hans Island, between Canada and Greenland.
qs.sayAnswer: True! In 2022 they split tiny Hans Island, between Canada and Greenland.

title: FAMOUS
CITIES
TRUE/FALSE
hook: True or false? Five facts about famous cities, three seconds each. The last city is slowly disappearing!

qs.q: Dubai is the capital of the United Arab Emirates.
qs.fact: The capital is Abu Dhabi. Dubai is the largest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Abu Dhabi. Dubai is just the largest city.

qs.q: Istanbul lies on two continents.
qs.fact: The Bosphorus strait splits the city between Europe and Asia.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The Bosphorus strait splits the city between Europe and Asia.

qs.q: Paris is farther north than Montreal.
qs.fact: Paris sits at 48.9° north. Montreal is at 45.5° north.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Paris is more than 3 degrees of latitude north of Montreal.

qs.q: Casablanca is the capital of Morocco.
qs.fact: The capital is Rabat. Casablanca is the biggest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Rabat. Casablanca is only the biggest city.

qs.q: Mexico City is sinking a little more every year.
qs.fact: Groundwater pumping makes parts of the city sink about 35 cm a year.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Pumping out groundwater makes parts of the city sink about 35 centimeters a year.

title: USA
MAP
SURPRISES
hook: True or false? Five more U.S. map surprises, three seconds each. Grab a map for the last one!

qs.q: Texas is the largest US state.
qs.say: Texas is the largest U.S. state.
qs.fact: Alaska is the largest, about two and a half times the size of Texas.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Alaska is the largest, about two and a half times the size of Texas.

qs.q: From Detroit, you travel south to reach Canada.
qs.fact: Windsor, Ontario lies directly south of Detroit, across the river.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Windsor, Ontario lies directly south of Detroit, just across the river.

qs.q: Chicago is the capital of Illinois.
qs.fact: The capital is Springfield. Chicago is the biggest city.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Springfield. Chicago is only the biggest city.

qs.q: Alaska's capital, Juneau, cannot be reached by road.
qs.fact: No roads connect Juneau to the rest of North America. You fly or sail in.
qs.sayAnswer: True! No roads lead to Juneau. You have to arrive by plane or by boat.

qs.q: Part of Virginia lies farther west than Detroit.
qs.fact: Virginia's western tip reaches 83.7° west. Detroit is at 83.0° west.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Virginia's long western tip stretches past the longitude of Detroit.

title: AFRICA
FACTS
OR FAKES?
hook: True or false? Five facts about Africa, three seconds each. The last one ruins a famous assumption!

qs.q: The Nile flows from south to north.
qs.fact: It flows north through Egypt and empties into the Mediterranean.
qs.sayAnswer: True! It flows north through Egypt and empties into the Mediterranean Sea.

qs.q: It has snowed in the Sahara Desert.
qs.fact: Snow fell on the dunes near Ain Sefra, Algeria, in 1979 and again in 2016.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Snow has dusted the dunes near Ain Sefra in Algeria more than once.

qs.q: The Cape of Good Hope is Africa's southernmost point.
qs.fact: That is Cape Agulhas, about 55 km farther south.
qs.sayAnswer: False! That is Cape Agulhas, about 55 kilometers farther south.

qs.q: Africa is the only continent in all four hemispheres.
qs.fact: Both the Equator and the prime meridian cross Africa.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Both the Equator and the prime meridian run right through Africa.

qs.q: Egypt has more pyramids than any other country.
qs.fact: Sudan has at least 230 pyramids. Egypt has about 120 to 140.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Sudan has more than 200 pyramids. Egypt has fewer than 150.

title: POLAR
FACTS
OR FAKES?
hook: True or false? Five facts from the ends of the Earth, three seconds each. The last one looks like a horror movie!

qs.q: Polar bears live in Antarctica.
qs.fact: Polar bears live only in the Arctic, around the North Pole.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Polar bears live only in the Arctic, on the other side of the planet.

qs.q: The South Pole is colder than the North Pole.
qs.fact: The South Pole sits high on land. The North Pole floats at sea level.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The South Pole sits high up on land. The North Pole is at sea level.

qs.q: Antarctica has an active volcano.
qs.fact: Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano on Earth.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano on Earth.

qs.q: The North Pole sits on solid land.
qs.fact: There is only drifting sea ice over the Arctic Ocean. No land at all.
qs.sayAnswer: False! There is no land there, only sea ice drifting over the Arctic Ocean.

qs.q: A blood-red waterfall flows from a glacier in Antarctica.
qs.fact: Blood Falls: salty, iron-rich water that turns red in the air.
qs.sayAnswer: True! It is called Blood Falls. Salty, iron-rich water turns rusty red in the air.

title: LAKES &
WATERFALLS
TRUE/FALSE
hook: True or false? Five facts about lakes, seas and waterfalls. Three seconds each. Don't trust the names!

qs.q: The Dead Sea is actually a lake.
qs.fact: It is a landlocked salt lake between Jordan and Israel.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Despite the name, it is a landlocked salt lake.

qs.q: Angel Falls is in Brazil.
qs.fact: The 979 m waterfall is in Venezuela.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The 979 meter waterfall is in Venezuela.

qs.q: Niagara Falls is the tallest waterfall in North America.
qs.fact: Niagara drops about 57 m. Yosemite Falls drops 739 m.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Niagara drops about 57 meters. Yosemite Falls drops 739.

qs.q: Lake Baikal holds about a fifth of Earth's fresh surface water.
qs.fact: Baikal in Siberia holds more water than all the Great Lakes combined.
qs.sayAnswer: True! One Siberian lake holds more water than all 5 Great Lakes combined.

qs.q: The Sargasso Sea has no coastline at all.
qs.fact: It is the only sea bounded by ocean currents instead of land.
qs.sayAnswer: True! It is the only sea bordered by ocean currents instead of land.

title: EUROPE
ROUND
TWO
hook: True or false? Five more facts about Europe, three seconds each. Careful with the very last one!

qs.q: Venice is built on more than 100 islands.
qs.fact: The city spreads across roughly 120 small islands linked by bridges.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The city spreads across roughly 120 small islands linked by bridges.

qs.q: Switzerland is a member of the European Union.
qs.fact: Switzerland sits in the middle of the EU but has never joined.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Switzerland is surrounded by the European Union but has never joined.

qs.q: Italy completely surrounds two other countries.
qs.fact: San Marino and Vatican City both lie entirely inside Italy.
qs.sayAnswer: True! San Marino and Vatican City both lie entirely inside Italy.

qs.q: London is farther north than Calgary, Canada.
qs.fact: London sits at 51.5° north. Calgary is at 51.0° north.
qs.sayAnswer: True! London is about half a degree of latitude north of Calgary.

qs.q: Holland is the official name of the Netherlands.
qs.fact: Holland is only a region: two of the country's twelve provinces.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Holland is only a region on the country's west coast.

title: TÜRKİYE
FACT OR
FAKE?
hook: True or false? Five more facts about Turkey, three seconds each. The last one rewrote the history books!

qs.q: Türkiye uses a single time zone.
qs.say: Turkey uses a single time zone.
qs.fact: The whole country has been on UTC+3 all year round since 2016.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The whole country runs on 1 time, with no clock changes since 2016.

qs.q: The Bosphorus connects the Black Sea to the Aegean Sea.
qs.fact: It links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.

qs.q: The Tigris and the Euphrates both begin in Türkiye.
qs.say: The Tigris and the Euphrates both begin in Turkey.
qs.fact: Both great rivers rise in the mountains of eastern Türkiye.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Both great rivers rise in the mountains of eastern Turkey.

qs.q: Lake Van, Türkiye's largest lake, is a freshwater lake.
qs.say: Lake Van, Turkey's largest lake, is a freshwater lake.
qs.fact: Lake Van is a salty soda lake with no outlet.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Lake Van is a salty soda lake with no outlet.

qs.q: Göbekli Tepe in Türkiye is thousands of years older than Stonehenge.
qs.say: Gobekli Tepe in Turkey is thousands of years older than Stonehenge.
qs.fact: Built around 9500 BCE, it predates Stonehenge by some 6,000 years.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Its carved stone pillars are about 6000 years older than Stonehenge.

title: THE
AMERICAS
TRUE/FALSE
hook: True or false? Five facts about the Americas, three seconds each. Number five twists your mental map!

qs.q: Ecuador is named after the Equator.
qs.fact: Ecuador is simply the Spanish word for equator.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Ecuador is simply the Spanish word for equator.

qs.q: The Amazon rainforest lies entirely in Brazil.
qs.fact: Only about 60% is in Brazil. Peru, Colombia and others share the rest.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Only about 60 percent is in Brazil. 8 other countries share the rest.

qs.q: Brazil is named after a tree.
qs.fact: The name comes from brazilwood, a tree prized for its red dye.
qs.sayAnswer: True! The name comes from brazilwood, a tree once prized for its red dye.

qs.q: Aconcagua, the highest peak outside Asia, is in Chile.
qs.fact: It stands in Argentina, close to the Chilean border.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It stands in Argentina, close to the border with Chile.

qs.q: The Panama Canal's Atlantic end is west of its Pacific end.
qs.fact: The canal runs northwest to southeast across a bend in the isthmus.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Panama bends like an S, so ships heading to the Pacific actually sail southeast.

title: ASIA
TRUE OR
FALSE?
hook: True or false? Five facts about Asia, three seconds each. The last one catches people out!

qs.q: Kazakhstan is the world's largest landlocked country.
qs.fact: It is the ninth-largest country on Earth and has no ocean coast.
qs.sayAnswer: True! It is the ninth-largest country on Earth, with no ocean coastline.

qs.q: Bali is a country.
qs.fact: Bali is an island and a province of Indonesia.
qs.sayAnswer: False! Bali is an island and a province of Indonesia.

qs.q: The Maldives is the lowest-lying country on Earth.
qs.fact: Its natural ground rises no more than about 2.4 m above the sea.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Its natural ground rises only about 2 meters above the sea.

qs.q: China, as wide as the continental US, uses just one time zone.
qs.say: China, as wide as the continental U.S., uses just one time zone.
qs.fact: China spans five geographic time zones but uses only Beijing time.
qs.sayAnswer: True! China spans 5 geographic time zones but officially uses only Beijing time.

qs.q: Most Russians live in the Asian part of Russia.
qs.fact: About 80% of Russia's people live in the European part.
qs.sayAnswer: False! About 80 percent of Russia's people live in the European part.

title: WHAT'S IN
A NAME?
TRUE/FALSE
hook: True or false? Five facts about famous place names, three seconds each. Number five has gone to the dogs!

qs.q: The name of the Pacific Ocean means peaceful.
qs.fact: Magellan named it Mar Pacífico, the peaceful sea, in 1520.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Magellan named it the peaceful sea after finding calm waters.

qs.q: America is named after Christopher Columbus.
qs.fact: It is named after the Italian explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It is named after the Italian explorer Amerigo Vespucci.

qs.q: Argentina is named after the Latin word for silver.
qs.fact: Argentum is Latin for silver, like the Río de la Plata, the silver river.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Argentum is Latin for silver. Explorers hoped to find plenty of it there.

qs.q: New Zealand is named after a province of the Netherlands.
qs.fact: Dutch mapmakers named it after their coastal province of Zeeland.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Dutch mapmakers named it after their coastal province of Zeeland.

qs.q: The Canary Islands are named after canary birds.
qs.fact: The birds are named after the islands. The name likely comes from dogs.
qs.sayAnswer: False! It is the other way round. The name probably comes from the Latin for dogs.
